Since $364$ is larger than $206,$ the answer will be negative.

We start by solving an easier problem:

$$
364-206
$$

Next, we carry out the subtraction:

$$
\begin{aligned} &  & \,\,\, & \,\,\,\begin{aligned}\,\,\,5\end{aligned} & \,\,\,\begin{aligned}\,\,\,14\end{aligned} \\  &  & \,\,\,3\,\,\, & \,\,\,6\,\,\, & \,\,\,4\,\,\, \\ \,\,\,\,-\,\,\,\, &  & \,\,\,2\,\,\, & \,\,\,0\,\,\, & \,\,\,6\,\,\, \\  &  & \,\,\,1\,\,\, & \,\,\,5\,\,\, & \,\,\,8\,\,\,\end{aligned}
$$

So, we have

$$
364-206=158.
$$

However, since our answer must be negative, we need to change the sign of the answer above. 

Therefore, we conclude that

$$
206-364=-158.
$$
